title: 第11章  前往赤霞县驻所
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
来往的镇魔卫纷纷驻足，整个院子瞬间安静下来。

    陆渊嘴角勾起一抹漫不经心的冷笑。

    再说一遍又如何？

    第一次听到有人提出这种要求。

    “我说，你算什么东西，也配来主持公道！听清了吗？不行我再说一遍。”

    “陆渊！”

    周通暴喝一声，整个人就像是一头被激怒的黑熊。

    他可是在册七年的镇魔卫，杀过数百只妖魔，哪个新人不得客客气气喊他一声“周大人”？

    可眼前这个刚入门的小子居然在大庭广众之下羞辱他！

    周通一只手按在刀柄上，语气中透着森寒。

    “我是真没想到，你竟然会蠢到这种地步。”

    “你以为凭借一块直升腰牌就能加入镇魔司了？”

    “实话告诉你，像你这种资质的新人，就算进入镇魔司也只是个杂役！”

    “但我不一样，我是初境武者，更是在册七年的镇魔卫，你猜在这镇魔司之内，我跟你的份量孰轻孰重？”

    周通眼神凶狠，直视陆渊，试图在那张俊逸的脸上看出几分自卑慌乱的情绪。

    然而并没有。

    陆渊眼神平静，双眸之中的漠然如同古井。

    “三息。”

    他拉开右臂，灵力如渊似海轰然爆发，瞬间化作一层灵晶覆盖在小臂之上。

    “就三息，三息之后，你最好第一时间告诉我孰轻孰重。”

    他一拳轰出，重重砸在对方腰腹之上。

    轰！

    沛然巨力爆发，周通面露痛苦，一口鲜血狂喷出去。

    不过他毕竟是在册七年的镇魔卫，老练的战斗意识让他在第一时间便拔出了腰间横刀。

    可他却没想到，陆渊的速度比他更快。

    横刀还未出鞘，第二拳便已经轰出，如炮弹般砸在了他的脸上。

    准确的说，是嘴上。

    只听一声沉闷爆响，周通颌骨碎裂，嘴唇皮肉翻卷，碎牙混着鲜血掉落在地。

    “呃——”

    他口中发出含糊不清的音节，鲜血咳出，刀柄从手中滑落。

    在这种恐怖的巨力之下，他初境三层的修为显得脆弱不堪。

    一股无法言喻的挫败感从心底浮现。

    下一刻，他心脏狂跳，难以置信地瞪大双眼。

    不对！

    陆渊不是凡境二层吗？

    怎么会有灵力波动？
content_en:
The demon-suppressing guards coming and going stopped one after another, and the whole courtyard fell silent instantly.

    Lu Yuan's lips curved into a careless sneer.

    So what if I say it again?

    This is the first time I heard someone make such a request.

    "I said, you are worthy of upholding justice! Do you hear me clearly? If not, I will say it again."

    "Lu Yuan!"

    Zhou Tong shouted loudly, looking like an angry black bear.

    He has been a demon-suppressing guard for seven years and has killed hundreds of demons. What newcomer can't politely call him "Master Zhou"?

    But this young guy in front of him actually humiliated him in public!

    Zhou Tong put one hand on the handle of the knife, his tone filled with coldness.

    "I really didn't expect you to be so stupid."

    "Do you think you can join the Demon Suppression Division with just a promotion card?"

    "To tell you the truth, a newcomer with your qualifications will only be a handyman even if he joins the Demon Suppression Division!"

    "But I'm different. I'm a first-level warrior, and I've been a demon-suppressing guard for seven years. Do you think we are more important than you in this demon-suppressing division?"

    Zhou Tong looked directly at Lu Yuan with fierce eyes, trying to see a bit of inferiority and confusion on that handsome face.

    But no.

    Lu Yuan's eyes were calm, and the indifference in his eyes was like an ancient well.

    "Three breaths."

    He opened his right arm, and his spiritual power exploded like an abyss or sea, instantly turning into a layer of spiritual crystals covering his forearm.

    "Just three breaths. After three breaths, you'd better tell me which one is more serious."

    He punched out, hitting the opponent's waist and abdomen hard.

    boom!

    Peiran's huge force exploded, Zhou Tong's face showed pain, and a mouthful of blood spurted out.

    But after all, he was a demon-suppressing guard who had been registered for seven years, and his sophisticated fighting consciousness allowed him to pull out the horizontal sword at his waist immediately.

    But he didn't expect that Lu Yuan was faster than him.

    Before the Hengdao was unsheathed, the second punch had already been thrown out, hitting him in the face like a cannonball.

    Orally, to be precise.

    There was a dull explosion, Zhou Tong's jaw shattered, the flesh of his lips rolled, and his broken teeth fell to the ground mixed with blood.

    "Uh-"

    He uttered garbled syllables, coughed out blood, and the handle of the knife slipped from his hand.

    Under such terrifying power, his cultivation at the third level of the initial realm seemed fragile.

    An indescribable feeling of frustration emerged from the bottom of my heart.

    The next moment, his heart was beating wildly and his eyes widened in disbelief.

    wrong!

    Isn't Lu Yuan on the second level of the mortal realm?

    Why are there spiritual fluctuations?
